import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] dX = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dY = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    
    static int N, T, srcX, srcY;
    static String[] gridLab = new String[20];
    static String[] gridSci = new String[20];
    static int[][][][][] memo = new int[12][12][12][12][62];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[250][250];
    static int[] parent = new int[250];
    static int[][] distance = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] visited = new int[20][20];
    
    static boolean isValid(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < N && 0 <= y && y < N && 
               gridLab[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && gridLab[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }
    
    static void bfsPrecompute() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                distance[i][j] = 0x3f3f3f3f;
                visited[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        distance[srcX][srcY] = 0;
        visited[srcX][srcY] = 1;
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        qx.add(srcX);
        qy.add(srcY);
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qx.poll();
            int y = qy.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dX[k];
                int ny = y + dY[k];
                if (isValid(nx, ny) && visited[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    distance[nx][ny] = distance[x][y] + 1;
                    visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                    qx.add(nx);
                    qy.add(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static int dfsPath(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int step) {
        if (step > T) return 0;
        int res = memo[x0][y0][x1][y1][step];
        if (res != -1) return res;
        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) return distance[x0][y0] >= step ? 1 : 0;
        if (distance[x0][y0] <= step) return memo[x0][y0][x1][y1][step] = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int nx = x0 + dX[k];
            int ny = y0 + dY[k];
            if (isValid(nx, ny) && dfsPath(nx, ny, x1, y1, step + 1) == 1) {
                return memo[x0][y0][x1][y1][step] = 1;
            }
        }
        return memo[x0][y0][x1][y1][step] = 0;
    }
    
    static boolean bfs(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        parent[source] = -2;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(source);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int i = source; i <= sink; i++) {
                if (parent[i] == -1 && capacity[v][i] > 0) {
                    parent[i] = v;
                    q.add(i);
                }
            }
        }
        return parent[sink] != -1;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            gridSci[i] = sc.next();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            gridLab[i] = sc.next();
        }
        
        List<int[]> positions = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> labCap = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> sciCap = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (gridSci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    srcX = i;
                    srcY = j;
                } else if (gridSci[i].charAt(j) >= '0' && gridSci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    positions.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    labCap.add(gridLab[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    sciCap.add(gridSci[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        int M = positions.size();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; l++) {
                        Arrays.fill(memo[i][j][k][l], -1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 250; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(capacity[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            capacity[0][i + 1] = sciCap.get(i);
            capacity[M + 1 + i][2 * M + 1] = labCap.get(i);
        }
        
        bfsPrecompute();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                if (dfsPath(positions.get(i)[0], positions.get(i)[1], 
                           positions.get(j)[0], positions.get(j)[1], 0) == 1) {
                    capacity[i + 1][M + 1 + j] = 1000;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int maxFlow = 0;
        while (bfs(0, 2 * M + 1)) {
            int sink = 2 * M + 1;
            int bottleneck = 1000000;
            int tempSink = sink;
            while (parent[tempSink] >= 0) {
                bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, capacity[parent[tempSink]][tempSink]);
                tempSink = parent[tempSink];
            }
            tempSink = sink;
            while (parent[tempSink] >= 0) {
                capacity[parent[tempSink]][tempSink] -= bottleneck;
                capacity[tempSink][parent[tempSink]] += bottleneck;
                tempSink = parent[tempSink];
            }
            maxFlow += bottleneck;
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxFlow);
    }
}
